recovery_candidates.note: Unverified candidate. Confirm shift, approvals, access, training, and task suitability.

methodology.model: Deterministic bottleneck capacity stress test; not a calibrated forecast
methodology.facility_outage: Onsite-only employees unavailable; hybrid/remote eligible staff assumed offsite-capable; locally hosted systems offline
methodology.readiness: Criticality-weighted task-rate coverage relative to fully efficient baseline assigned FTE; limited by staffing, headcount, enabled human variables and systems
methodology.skills: Enabled: task-relevant proficiency affects employee efficiency and minimum-qualified-person coverage
methodology.experience: Enabled: explicit years in role OR similar-task counts affect efficiency; organizational tenure is not treated as measured role experience
methodology.relationships: Enabled: directed workflow handoffs, collaboration frequency and unavailable endpoints affect coordination delay; degree centrality is diagnostic
methodology.timing: Illustrative aggregate task completion time and fluid throughput, not an event/queue simulation. Duration is modeled working hours; no shifts or restoration. Blocked task time is null, throughput is zero
methodology.calibration: Synthetic demonstration inputs and assumed coefficients; no observed outcomes, accuracy estimates, or validated prediction improvement
methodology.employee_updates: Scenario-local overrides; saved employee records are unchanged. Baseline uses original inputs without disruption; model comparisons use the same updated employees
methodology.recovery: Candidates do not alter modeled coverage; validation and approval required
